summary.text: Tony Tinderholt is a Republican State Representative for Texas House District 94 in Tarrant County, serving his fifth term. His official biography describes him as a retired combat veteran and says he serves on the Committee on Public Health and the Committee on County Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Tinderholt entered active duty in the Air Force in 1988 as a Spanish Cryptologic Linguist and, after 9/11, re-entered military service in the Army.
In his 21 years in the armed forces he earned awards including the Bronze Star Medal and Combat Action Badge, retiring as a Major.
In civilian life he previously served as a Spanish professor, holds a Master's Degree in Educational Leadership, and is a business owner in the Metroplex.
He and his wife, Bethany, have four children.
